skill.summary: Amazon AppConfig API skill. Use when working with Amazon AppConfig for applications, deploymentstrategies, extensions. Covers 45 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-amazon-appconfig.

- Provides Amazon AppConfig API integration with 45 endpoints.
- Supports operations for applications, deployment strategies, and extensions.
- Requires AWS SigV4 authentication and an AMAZON_APPCONFIG_API_KEY.
- Includes setup guidance and endpoint documentation for common AppConfig tasks.
